prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

(not available)

- choose_path: 80.4%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 90.4%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 73.1%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 89.6%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Path Mascot Showcase Split View: Redesigns the path selection step into a split layout view featuring a friendly mascot guide to assist users in selecting their onboarding path. (why: Choose path drop-off is 80.4% with a high mean completion time of 514 seconds, showing user hesitation during path selection.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Sync Status Hint: Adds an explicit explanatory hint on the sign-in screen informing returning users that their existing pets will automatically restore. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or reset after signing back into an account.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Readiness Countdown and Diagnostic Indicator: Replaces the waiting status screen with real-time system progress indicators and countdown timers while the desktop pet spawns. (why: 3 support emails reported desktop pet display bugs and app startup stalls, alongside a long median wait of 201 seconds.)
3: [finish, redesign] Desktop Pet Interaction Controls Card Layout: Redesigns the final intro screen into a clear grid card layout outlining core desktop controls, tray icons, and shortcut hotkeys. (why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8%, and support received 3 emails from users confused about how to hide, show, or interact with their pet.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Fast Track Companion Path Copy: Updates headline and button text on the choose path screen to clarify setup duration between instant companion selection and custom design. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s, indicating users feel paralyzed by choice without clear duration expectations.)
5: [home, notification] Background Spawning Desktop Ready Sound Alert: Adds an optional sound chime and system notification toggle to alert users when pet initialization completes. (why: The waiting step has a mean duration of 2336 seconds, indicating users switch away to other desktop apps while waiting.)
6: [finish, hint] Tray Menu and Desktop Visibility Hint: Adds a hint on the finish screen explaining system tray controls and keyboard shortcuts for pet visibility. (why: Support logged 3 issues regarding confusion on how to control or hide pets after completing onboarding.)
